words.gloss: by the power of fort and country
by a quarter of the revenue

hindi: दुर्ग और जनपद की शक्ति से सेवकों के कर्म को आय के चतुर्थांश पर स्थापित करे, अथवा कार्य सिद्ध करने में समर्थ सेवकों की प्राप्ति द्वारा।
english: By the power of fort and country he should fix the servants' work (karma) at a quarter of the revenue, or by the acquisition of servants capable of accomplishing the work.
notes: bhṛtya-karma follows the glossary (karma = action); it is taken to mean 'servants' work' (the charge for servants, i.e. their pay, is the usual sense); samudaya = revenue; sahena = 'able, capable' (saha √sah). The second alternative is elliptical; the exact sense of 'or by acquisition of servants' is uncertain. Reviewer: karma here is rendered 'work' (glossary 5.3 amends karma = action for the work or service of servants); the draft note above that says 'follows karma = action' is superseded.
lines_deva: दुर्ग.जन.पद.शक्त्या भृत्य.कर्म समुदय.पादेन स्थापयेत्, कार्य.साधन.सहेन वा भृत्य.लाभेन
lines_iast: durga.jana.pada.śaktyā bhṛtya.karma samudaya.pādena sthāpayet, kārya.sādhana.sahena vā bhṛtya.lābhena

hindi: शरीर का ध्यान रखे; धर्म और अर्थ को पीड़ा न पहुँचाए।
english: He should look to the body; he should not harm dharma and wealth (artha).
notes: śarīra is taken literally as 'the body'; whose body (the king's own, or the body politic) is not stated in the line. 'Look to' could also be 'attend to, consider'.

words.gloss: officiating priest, teacher, minister, chaplain, commander of the army, heir-apparent, king's mother, king's

hindi: ऋत्विक्, आचार्य, मन्त्री, पुरोहित, सेनापति, युवराज, राजमाता और राजमहिषियाँ अड़तालीस हज़ार वाले होते हैं।
english: The officiating priest, teacher, minister, chaplain, commander of the army, heir-apparent, king's mother and king's chief queens are [those] of forty-eight thousand.
notes: Unit has the line-break join 'rāja.- mahiṣyo' (compound continues into the next token). The unit of money (paṇa) is not stated in the line; sāhasra = 'of a thousand', here 'having 48,000 [as pay]'. mahiṣī is taken as 'chief queen'; the plural is kept.

hindi: इतने भरण-पोषण से इनमें अनास्पद्यत्व और क्रोध का अभाव होता है।
english: With this much maintenance there comes to be in them anāspadyatva (the state of having no footing) and freedom from anger.
notes: Obscure word kept literal: anāspadyatva = 'the state of not being a footing/place (āspada)'; the object it refers to is not stated (commentators: not being open to enemy seduction, or not becoming objects of ...). akopaka is taken as 'free of anger'; an alternative is 'not causing anger/revolt'. Tokens 'bharaṇena-anāspadyatvam' and 'ca-eṣām' are unsandhied joins.

hindi: दौवारिक, अन्तर्वंशिक, प्रशास्ता, समाहर्ता और सन्निधाता चौबीस हज़ार वाले होते हैं।
english: The dauvārika (door-keeper), antarvaṃśika, praśāstṛ, Collector and Treasurer are [those] of twenty-four thousand.
notes: antarvaṃśika is an obscure office title (literally 'of the inner [bamboo/staff]'); kept untranslated. dauvārika = door-keeper (literal). Glossary renderings for praśāstṛ, samāhartṛ, sannidhātṛ.

hindi: इतने से वे कर्म करने योग्य होते हैं।
english: With this much they become fit for work.
notes: Src 'karmaṇyā' is the printed form (visarga lost before bh-); read karmaṇyāḥ. Reviewer: the text_flag on 'karmaṇyā' is a false positive. Final -āḥ before a voiced consonant (bh-) regularly loses its visarga (āḥ + bh- gives ā bh-), exactly as in 'mukhyā hasty' (unit 9). No typo; the flag may be dropped by a person.

words.gloss: prince, prince's mother, nāyaka, townsman, vyāvahārika, kārmāntika, ministers'
council (of ministers, continued), and frontier officers of the country

hindi: कुमार, कुमार की माता, नायक, नगरवासी, व्यावहारिक, कार्मान्तिक, मन्त्रिपरिषद् और राष्ट्र के अन्तपाल बारह हज़ार वाले होते हैं।
english: The prince, the prince's mother, the nāyaka, the townsman, the vyāvahārika, the kārmāntika, the council of ministers and the frontier officers of the country are [those] of twelve thousand.
notes: Compound continues across the line-break join 'mantri.- pariṣad'. nāyaka, vyāvahārika and kārmāntika are kept as titles (vyāvahārika = one concerned with legal business; kārmāntika = one concerned with works): sense not fixed. The grouping of the members of the long compound is uncertain: 'mantri-pariṣad' (council of ministers) is taken as one member, 'rāṣṭra-anta-pāla' as 'guards of the country's frontier'. Plural 'kumāra' not marked in the compound.

words.gloss: the king's paribandha, army and helpers

hindi: क्योंकि इतने से वे स्वामी के परिबन्ध, सेना और सहायक होते हैं।
english: For with this much they become the king's paribandha, army and helpers.
notes: paribandha is obscure (literally 'binding round'; perhaps 'retinue, entourage' or 'bond/security'); kept untranslated. The compound could instead be a bahuvrīhi 'having the king's retinue, army and helpers'. Not fixed. Reviewer: bala may be 'strength' rather than 'army' (glossary bala = army in its force sense); kept 'army'. The case is open whether svāmi- governs only paribandha or all three members.

words.gloss: chiefs of elephants, horses and chariots

hindi: श्रेणियों के मुखिया, हाथी, घोड़े और रथ के मुखिया तथा प्रदेष्टा आठ हज़ार वाले होते हैं।
english: The chiefs of the guilds, the chiefs of elephants, horses and chariots, and the pradeṣṭṛs are [those] of eight thousand.
notes: Src 'mukhyā' is printed without visarga before 'hasty' (a regular sandhi: ḥ drops after ā before a voiced sound). pradeṣṭṛ is kept as a title (from pra-√diś, 'one who directs/assigns'). 'ca-aṣṭa.sāhasrāḥ' is an unsandhied join.

hindi: क्योंकि इतने से वे अपने वर्ग को साथ खींचने वाले होते हैं।
english: For with this much they become those who draw their own group along with them.
notes: anukarṣin literally 'drawing after'; 'varga' = group, party.

words.gloss: superintendents of foot-soldiers, horses, chariots and elephants
guards of the dravya and elephant forests

hindi: पैदल, घोड़े, रथ और हाथी के अध्यक्ष तथा द्रव्य-वन और हाथी-वन के रक्षक चार हज़ार वाले होते हैं।
english: The superintendents of foot-soldiers, horses, chariots and elephants, and the guards of the dravya forests and elephant forests, are [those] of four thousand.
notes: dravya-hasti-vana-pāla: taken as 'guard of the dravya-forests and the elephant-forests'; dravya = 'material, substance' (kept as dravya). Alternative grouping: 'guards of the forests of dravya and elephants'.

hindi: रथिक, अनीकस्थ, चिकित्सक, अश्वदमक, वर्धकि तथा योनि-पोषक दो हज़ार वाले होते हैं।
english: The rathikas, the anīkasthas, the physicians, the horse-trainers, the carpenters and the yoni-poṣakas are [those] of two thousand.
notes: Src 'vardhakayo' = vardhakayaḥ (nom. pl. of vardhaki, carpenter). rathika (one of the chariot) and anīkastha (literally 'standing in the division/front') are obscure titles, kept untranslated. yoni-poṣaka literally 'nourisher of the womb/source'; 'rearers of the breed' is a literal-ish reading, uncertain.

words.gloss: fortune-teller, omen-reader, astrologer, Purāṇa-reciter, bards and minstrels

hindi: ज्योतिषी, नैमित्तिक, मौहूर्तिक, पौराणिक, सूत और मागध, पुरोहित के पुरुष तथा सब अध्यक्ष हज़ार वाले होते हैं।
english: The fortune-tellers, omen-readers, astrologers, Purāṇa-reciters, bards and minstrels, the chaplain's men and all the superintendents are [those] of one thousand.
notes: paurāṇika = one concerned with the Purāṇa(s) ('Purāṇa-reciter' is a literal reading). sūta-māgadha = bards and minstrels (glossary). The line has no verb; 'are [men] of' is a bare copula.

words.gloss: group of accountants, scribes and the like

hindi: शिल्पवान् जन, पैदल सैनिक तथा गणक, लेखक आदि का वर्ग पाँच सौ वाले होते हैं।
english: The skilled men, the foot-soldiers, and the group of accountants, scribes and the like are [those] of five hundred.
notes: śilpavantaḥ pādātāḥ may be one phrase ('skilled foot-soldiers') or two groups; two groups taken. saṅkhyāyaka = accountant (one who counts).

words.gloss: of two and a half hundred

hindi: किन्तु कुशीलव ढाई सौ वाले होते हैं; और इनमें तूर्य करने वाले दुगुने वेतन वाले होते हैं।
english: The kuśīlavas, however, are [those] of two and a half hundred; and of these the tūrya-karas are of double pay.
notes: kuśīlava (commonly 'actor, bard') kept as a name. tūrya-kara literally 'maker/doer of tūrya (a musical instrument)'; whether 'players' or 'makers' is not fixed. ardha-tṛtīya = 'two and a half' (literally 'third with half'), so 250. Src 'dvi.guṇa.vetanāś' = dvi-guṇa-vetanāḥ; 'ca-eṣām' is an unsandhied join.
lines_deva: कुशीलवास् त्व् अर्ध.तृतीय.शताः, द्वि.गुण.वेतनाश् च-एषां तूर्य.कराः
lines_iast: kuśīlavās tv ardha.tṛtīya.śatāḥ, dvi.guṇa.vetanāś ca-eṣāṃ tūrya.karāḥ

hindi: कारु और शिल्पी बीस सौ वाले होते हैं।
english: The artisans and craftsmen are [those] of twenty hundreds.
notes: viṃśati-śatika is taken literally ('having twenty hundreds'); the figure intended (2000, or 120 by a different idiom) is not fixed here; the neighbouring units (500, 250, 1000) make 120 the likelier amount. kāru = artisan, śilpin = craftsman (literal). Reviewer: 'twenty hundreds' reads as 2000, higher than the thousand-groups of units 13 and 21; the descending run 1000, 500, 250 suggests 120. Kept literal; a person must decide (no patch to the number).

words.gloss: attendants of quadrupeds and bipeds, pārikarmikas, aupasthāyikas, keepers, and
āryas, yuktas, ārohakas, māṇavakas and rock-diggers

hindi: चौपायों और दोपायों के परिचारक, पारिकर्मिक, औपस्थायिक, पालक तथा विष्टि-बन्धक साठ वेतन वाले होते हैं; आर्य, युक्त, आरोहक, माणवक, शैल खोदने वाले और सब उपस्थायी —
english: The attendants of quadrupeds and bipeds, the pārikarmikas, the aupasthāyikas, the keepers and the binders of forced labour (viṣṭi) are of sixty pay; the āryas, yuktas, ārohakas, māṇavakas, the diggers of rock, and all the attendants —
notes: Compound continues across the line-break join 'pālaka.- viṣṭi'. pārikarmika and aupasthāyika are obscure titles, kept untranslated. viṣṭi-bandhaka literally 'binder(s) of forced labour'; sense uncertain. In the second clause there is no predicate and no pay: it is left open (it may continue 'of sixty pay'). ārya, yukta, ārohaka, māṇavaka are kept as titles; śaila-khanaka literally 'rock-digger'. 'sarva-upasthāyinaś ca' could also be 'and all attendants' as an added class.

hindi: आचार्य और विद्वान् पूजा-वेतन योग्यता के अनुसार पाएँ: कम से कम पाँच सौ, अधिक से अधिक हज़ार।
english: The teachers and the learned should receive honorary pay (pūjā-vetana) according to merit, five hundred at the least and a thousand at the most.
notes: pūjā-vetana is literal 'pay of honour'. vidyāvantaḥ = 'possessed of learning'. 'avara' = lowest, 'para' = highest.
lines_deva: आचार्या विद्यावन्तश् च पूजा.वेतनानि यथा.अर्हं लभेरन् पञ्च.शत.अवरं सहस्र.परम्
lines_iast: ācāryā vidyāvantaś ca pūjā.vetanāni yathā.arhaṃ labheran pañca.śata.avaraṃ sahasra.param

hindi: मध्यम दूत एक योजन के लिए दस पण वाला होता है; दस योजन से आगे दुगुने वेतन वाला, सौ योजन तक।
english: The envoy of the middle rank [has] ten paṇas for a yojana; beyond ten [yojanas] he is of double pay, up to a hundred yojanas.
notes: The line is elliptical: 'ten paṇas for a yojana' (rate per yojana) is the literal sense; 'beyond ten' is taken as beyond ten yojanas. The closing 'iti' is not rendered. 'madhyamaḥ' = middle rank of envoy (the other ranks are in neighbouring text), not 'the middle king'. Src 'vetana' is printed without visarga before 'ā' (regular sandhi).
lines_deva: दश.पणिको योजने दूतो मध्यमः, दश.उत्तरे द्वि.गुण.वेतन आ.योजन.शताद् इति
lines_iast: daśa.paṇiko yojane dūto madhyamaḥ, daśa.uttare dvi.guṇa.vetana ā.yojana.śatād iti

words.gloss: in the Rājasūya and the rest

hindi: समान विद्या वालों के लिए राजा राजसूय आदि यज्ञों में तिगुने वेतन वाला होता है।
english: For [those] of equal learning, the king [is] of triple pay in sacrifices such as the Rājasūya.
notes: Syntax unclear: the literal words are 'from/for those of equal learning, the king, triple pay, in sacrifices beginning with the Rājasūya'. Possible sense: at such sacrifices the priests/learned receive three times the pay of others of equal learning; the king as the subject is awkward. Rendered literally, with a bare copula; sense not settled. Reviewer: agree with the literal rendering and low confidence; the dative/ablative samāna-vidyebhyaḥ may be an ablative of comparison ('than those of equal learning'), which is why the sentence is left literal.

hindi: राजा का सारथी हज़ार वाला होता है।
english: The king's charioteer is [a man] of one thousand.

words.gloss: agents in the guise of kāpaṭikas, udāsthitas, householders, traders and ascetics

hindi: कापटिक, उदास्थित, गृहपतिक, व्यापारी और तापस के वेश वाले गुप्तचर हज़ार वाले होते हैं।
english: The agents in the guise of kāpaṭikas, udāsthitas, householders, traders and ascetics are [those] of one thousand.
notes: Glossary rendering of X-vyañjana. kāpaṭika (literally 'of deceit') and udāsthita (literally 'stood up/ stationed away') are kept as technical names, not interpreted. gṛha-patika = householder.

words.gloss: village hirelings, secret agents, assassins, poisoners and female mendicants

hindi: ग्राम के भृतक, गुप्तचर, तीक्ष्ण, विष देने वाले और भिक्षुकियाँ पाँच सौ वाले होते हैं।
english: The village hirelings, secret agents, assassins, poisoners and female mendicants are [those] of five hundred.
notes: grāma-bhṛtaka is taken literally as 'village hireling' (one hired by the village); the exact class is not fixed. Glossary renderings for sattrin, tīkṣṇa, rasada. bhikṣukī is feminine (female mendicant).

words.gloss: of two and a half hundred

hindi: चर और सञ्चारी ढाई सौ वाले होते हैं, अथवा परिश्रम से बढ़े हुए वेतन वाले।
english: The spies (cāra) and wanderers are [those] of two and a half hundred, or have pay increased by exertion.
notes: cāra-sañcārin could be one phrase ('wandering spies') or a pair; the pair is taken. prayāsa = exertion, effort. The meaning of 'or [with] pay increased by exertion' (an alternative to the fixed figure) is not elaborated in the line. Src "'rdha" = ardha. Src 'vetanā' = vetanāḥ (regular sandhi).

hindi: सौ के वर्गों और हज़ार के वर्गों के अध्यक्ष भोजन और वेतन की प्राप्ति, आदेश और विक्षेप करें।
english: The superintendents of the groups of a hundred and the groups of a thousand should make the receipt of food and pay, the assignment (ādeśa) and the dispersal (vikṣepa).
notes: ādeśa and vikṣepa are rendered literally ('order/assignment', 'scattering/dispersal'); their technical sense here (assigning duties; distribution or deployment) is not fixed. 'Should see to' renders kuryuḥ ('should make/do').
lines_deva: शत.वर्ग.सहस्र.वर्गाणाम् अध्यक्षा भक्त.वेतन.लाभम् आदेशं विक्षेपं च कुर्युः
lines_iast: śata.varga.sahasra.vargāṇām adhyakṣā bhakta.vetana.lābham ādeśaṃ vikṣepaṃ ca kuryuḥ

words.gloss: in the protection and supervision of the king's parigraha, fort and country

hindi: और राजपरिग्रह, दुर्ग और राष्ट्र की रक्षा और देखरेख में विक्षेप न हो।
english: And no dispersal in the supervision and protection of the king's household (parigraha), the fort and the country.
notes: Predicate supplied only as a bare copula; the Hindi 'न हो' (let there not be) is the minimal supply. rāja-parigraha: parigraha is taken as 'household, retinue' (also 'possessions'); the order 'rakṣa-avekṣaṇa' is 'protection and supervision'. Src 'rakṣa' is the compound member form.

hindi: स्थायी मुखिया और अनेक मुखिया हों।
english: There should be permanent chiefs and several chiefs.
notes: Whether the groups have permanent chiefs and several chiefs (a plural leadership) is as the literal wording; the referent of the subject is the groups of the preceding unit.

hindi: कर्मों में मरे हुओं के पुत्र और पत्नियाँ भोजन और वेतन पाएँ।
english: The sons and wives of those who have died in work (karma) should receive food and pay.
notes: karmasu follows the glossary (karma = action); the natural sense is 'in the course of their duties, in service'. Reviewer: karmasu = in their work/duties; the English keeps the bare 'work (karma)' and adds no 'their'.

words.gloss: the young, the old and the sick

hindi: इनमें बालक, वृद्ध और रोगी अनुग्रह के योग्य हैं।
english: Of these, the young, the old and the sick are to be favoured.
notes: 'Of these' refers back to the sons and wives (and dependants) of the dead; anugrāhya = 'to be shown favour'. 'ca-eṣām' is an unsandhied join.

words.gloss: in the matters of the dead, the sick and women in childbirth

hindi: और मृतक, रोगी और प्रसूता के कृत्यों में इनके लिए अर्थ और मान का कर्म करे।
english: And in the matters concerning the dead, the sick and women in childbirth, he should do for them the action of wealth and honour.
notes: artha-māna-karma is rendered literally: 'action of wealth and honour' (gifts and honours); kṛtya = 'matter, rite, thing to be done'. Reviewer: artha-māna-karma keeps 'action' (an act of conferring, not service-work); the glossary 5.3 'work' rule covers only service. Sense of the whole phrase (gifts and honours) in doubt.

hindi: थोड़े कोश वाला कुप्य, पशु और खेत दे, और थोड़ा धन।
english: One with a small treasury should give raw materials, cattle and fields, and a little money.
notes: hiraṇya = gold (wealth in gold/coin); kept as 'gold'. Reviewer: hiraṇya = money (glossary); 'gold' is only a possible literal sense.
lines_deva: अल्प.कोशः कुप्य.पशु.क्षेत्राणि दद्यात्, अल्पं च हिरण्यम्
lines_iast: alpa.kośaḥ kupya.paśu.kṣetrāṇi dadyāt, alpaṃ ca hiraṇyam

words.gloss: for the purpose of establishing the dealings arisen in the village

hindi: अथवा सूने को बसाने के लिए उद्यत हुआ केवल धन दे, ग्राम नहीं, ग्राम में उत्पन्न व्यवहारों की स्थापना के लिए।
english: Or one who has set out to settle an empty [place] should give only money, not a village, for the purpose of establishing the dealings arisen in the village.
notes: śūnya is taken as 'empty' (uninhabited [land]); the noun is not stated. grāma-sañjāta-vyavahāra is rendered literally ('dealings/transactions arisen in the village'); the sense of the last clause (why a village is not given) is not settled. Subject is the king (not stated).
lines_deva: शून्यं वा निवेशयितुम् अभ्युत्थितो हिरण्यम् एव दद्यात्, न ग्रामं ग्राम.सञ्जात.व्यवहार.स्थापन.अर्थम्
lines_iast: śūnyaṃ vā niveśayitum abhyutthito hiraṇyam eva dadyāt, na grāmaṃ grāma.sañjāta.vyavahāra.sthāpana.artham

hindi: इससे भरण किए हुओं और न किए हुओं के भोजन और वेतन में विद्या और कर्म के अनुसार भेद भी करे।
english: By this he should make a difference in food and pay for the maintained and the unmaintained, also according to learning and work (karma).
notes: bhṛta/abhṛta literally 'maintained/not maintained' (alternative: 'hired/unhired', or 'those already paid/not yet paid'). 'etena' = 'by this', i.e. by the method just described. karma follows the glossary (action); 'work' is the natural sense. The first 'ca' joins bhṛtānām/abhṛtānām, the second joins the clause.
lines_deva: एतेन भृतानाम् अभृतानां च विद्या.कर्मभ्यां भक्त.वेतन.विशेषं च कुर्यात्
lines_iast: etena bhṛtānām abhṛtānāṃ ca vidyā.karmabhyāṃ bhakta.vetana.viśeṣaṃ ca kuryāt

hindi: साठ वेतन वाले के लिए आढक करके, धन के अनुरूप भोजन निर्धारित करे।
english: Having made an āḍhaka for [one] of sixty pay, he should make the food in proportion to the money.
notes: āḍhaka is a measure of grain, kept untranslated; what it measures (the daily/monthly ration) is not stated in the line. Src 'vetanasya-āḍhakam' is an unsandhied join.

hindi: पैदल, घोड़े, रथ और हाथी सूर्योदय के समय बाहर, सन्धि-दिवसों को छोड़कर, शिल्प का अभ्यास करें।
english: Foot-soldiers, horses, chariots and elephants should perform exercises in skill (śilpa) at sunrise outside, excepting the junction days.
notes: śilpa-yogyāḥ is taken as the noun yogyā 'exercise, practice' (f. acc. pl.), 'exercises in skill', object of kuryuḥ; the alternative is the adjective 'fit for the craft' with no object. sandhi-divasa is rendered literally ('junction day'); which days are meant (e.g. conjunction of lunar phases) is not stated in the line. Whether 'bahiḥ' is 'outside the city' is not stated.
lines_deva: पत्त्य्.अश्व.रथ.द्विपाः सूर्य.उदये बहिः सन्धि.दिवस.वर्जं शिल्प.योग्याः कुर्युः
lines_iast: patty.aśva.ratha.dvipāḥ sūrya.udaye bahiḥ sandhi.divasa.varjaṃ śilpa.yogyāḥ kuryuḥ

hindi: उनमें राजा सदा तत्पर रहे और बार-बार इनके शिल्प का दर्शन करे।
english: In these the king should be constantly engaged, and he should often view their skill.
notes: 'teṣu' = 'in them' (the troops of the previous unit). nitya-yukta = 'always engaged/attentive'.
lines_deva: तेषु राजा नित्य.युक्तः स्यात्, अभीक्ष्णं च-एषां शिल्प.दर्शनं कुर्यात्
lines_iast: teṣu rājā nitya.yuktaḥ syāt, abhīkṣṇaṃ ca-eṣāṃ śilpa.darśanaṃ kuryāt

hindi: नरेन्द्र के चिह्न से अंकित शस्त्र और कवच को आयुध-भवन में प्रवेश कराए।
english: He should cause the weapons and armour, marked with the king's sign, to enter the armoury.
notes: nara-indra literally 'lord of men' = king. aṅka = mark, sign. āvaraṇa = covering (armour).

words.gloss: than what is permitted by a pass

hindi: वे बिना शस्त्र के चलें-फिरें, मुद्रा से अनुमत को छोड़कर।
english: They should move about unarmed, except [what is] permitted by a pass (mudrā).
notes: Subject (the soldiers) is not stated. 'anyatra + ablative' = 'except, other than'; what is excepted (the carrying of weapons by pass-holders) is read literally.

hindi: खो जाने या नष्ट हो जाने पर दुगुना दे।
english: [If it is] lost or destroyed, he should give double.
notes: Printed 'naṣṭaṃ.vinaṣṭaṃ' joins the two words as a compound (naṣṭa-vinaṣṭa). Neither the subject (the man who was issued the weapon) nor 'double of what' (the value) is stated.

hindi: नष्ट हुए की गणना भी करे।
english: And he should make a count of the destroyed [things].
notes: vidhvasta = destroyed, broken; the noun is not stated.

hindi: सार्थिकों के शस्त्र और कवच को अन्तपाल ले लें, अथवा समुद्र में उतरवा दें।
english: The frontier officers should take the weapons and armour of the caravan-members, or cause [them] to go down to the sea.
notes: sārthika is literally 'belonging to a caravan (sārtha)'. samudram avacārayeyuḥ is rendered literally ('make go down to the sea'); the sense (have them cast or carried into the sea, or taken down to the coast) is not fixed. Glossary rendering of anta-pāla.
lines_deva: सार्थिकानां शस्त्र.आवरणम् अन्त.पाला गृह्णीयुः, समुद्रम् अवचारयेयुर् वा
lines_iast: sārthikānāṃ śastra.āvaraṇam anta.pālā gṛhṇīyuḥ, samudram avacārayeyur vā

hindi: अथवा यात्रा के लिए उद्यत हुआ सेना को उद्यत करे।
english: Or, having set out on a march, he should set the army in motion.
notes: yātrā = expedition, march. udyojayet is 'should rouse/set in motion' (literal 'cause to yoke up').

words.gloss: agents in the guise of traders
at the time of the march
to be taken back at double

hindi: तब व्यापारी के वेश वाले गुप्तचर यात्रा के समय आयुधीयों को सब पण्य दुगुना वापस लेने योग्य रूप में दें।
english: Then the agents in the guise of traders should give all wares to the soldiers (āyudhīya) at the time of the march, to be taken back at double.
notes: āyudhīya literally 'one who lives by weapons' = soldier. 'Taken back at double' (dvi-guṇa-pratyādeya) is literal: the wares are to be recovered at twice [the price/value]. Glossary rendering of X-vyañjana, vaidehaka.
lines_deva: ततो वैदेहक.व्यञ्जनाः सर्व.पण्यान्य् आयुधीयेभ्यो यात्रा.काले द्वि.गुण.प्रत्यादेयानि दद्युः
lines_iast: tato vaidehaka.vyañjanāḥ sarva.paṇyāny āyudhīyebhyo yātrā.kāle dvi.guṇa.pratyādeyāni dadyuḥ

words.gloss: sale of the king's wares by yoga

hindi: इस प्रकार राजा के पण्य का योग से विक्रय और वेतन की वापसी होती है।
english: Thus there is the sale of the king's wares by yoga, and the taking back of pay.
notes: yoga in rāja-paṇya-yoga-vikraya is left as 'yoga' (the possible senses are 'contrivance', 'application', 'combination'; the glossary yoga = secret contrivance (Book 12) or acquisition (6.2) are not clearly fitting). Alternative: 'sale in connection with the king's wares'. Sense not settled. Reviewer: yoga left as 'yoga' (योग); contrivance, application and combination all fit and are used in other books. A person must decide; no change made.

words.gloss: one who has examined income and expenditure
calamity of the treasury and the army

hindi: इस प्रकार आय और व्यय को देखने वाला कोश और दण्ड के व्यसन को प्राप्त नहीं होता।
english: Thus one who has examined income and expenditure does not incur calamity of the treasury and the army.
notes: Glossary: vyasana = calamity; daṇḍa as a prakṛti = army. 'na-avāpnoti' is an unsandhied join.

words.gloss: the alternatives of food and pay

hindi: ये भोजन और वेतन के विकल्प हैं।
english: Such are the alternatives of food and pay.
notes: Colophon-style line closing the passage on food and pay. 'iti' is read as 'such, thus' marking the end; not rendered as a quotation close.

hindi: गुप्तचर, वेश्याएँ, कारु और कुशीलव तथा दण्ड में वृद्ध हुए जन, अथक रहकर, आयुधीयों की शुद्धता और अशुद्धता को जानें।
english: The secret agents, courtesans, artisans and kuśīlavas, and those grown old in the army, should, unwearied, find out the purity and impurity of the soldiers.
notes: 'ca-āyudhīyānām' is an unsandhied join. daṇḍa-vṛddha is read literally as 'aged/grown old in the army (daṇḍa)'; alternative 'grown old in the staff-office/punishment'. śauca-aśauca (purity/impurity) = honesty or dishonesty, kept literal. Two-line verse (two half-lines); grouping as printed.
